seo.title: Pest Protection Plans
seo.description: Year-round pest protection plans with scheduled visits, free re-treats and a field report every time. No contracts.

sections.heading: Year-round protection plans.
sections.body: One treatment wears off. A plan keeps a fresh barrier around your home all year, with visits timed to scorpion, monsoon and rodent seasons, and free re-treats whenever something gets through.

sections.heading: Pick your level of protection.
sections.intro: Every plan includes an initial inspection, a written field report on every visit and free re-treats between visits. Higher plans add pests and visit frequency.

tiers.name: Essential
features: Web and nest sweep every visit

tiers.name: Desert Shield
features: One UV scorpion hunt a year

sections.footnote: Plans renew monthly and can be cancelled any time. Prices are for homes up to 3,000 sq ft; larger properties are quoted at the free inspection.

sections.heading: Start a protection plan today.
sections.body: Keep pests out all year instead of chasing them every few months. Call the office or start online and we will match you to the right plan.

items.question: What is included in a protection plan?
items.answer: Every plan includes a full initial inspection, scheduled treatments inside and around the perimeter, a field report on every visit, and free re-treats between visits. Higher plans add scorpions, rodents, termite inspections and mosquitoes.

items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer: Yes. Move up or down at any time and the new price starts from your next billing date.

items.question: Is there a contract or cancellation fee?
items.answer: No. Plans are month to month. Cancel whenever you like.

items.question: What happens if I see pests between visits?
items.answer: Call or text and we come back free, usually within two business days.
